rationale: The agent located the user and relevant orders, but it processed a return (return_delivered_order_items) without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action beforehand. It also failed to provide the requested refund amount or any final information beyond a generic closing. Although it appears to have acted on the correct user, the missing confirmation and lack of refund details mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
